figures.name: 01_continuous_motion
figures.title: Shock carriers now follow velocity continuously
figures.caption: Blue paths are production RK2 particles. Orange paths are native MC controls with histories disabled. Both begin at seeded cell centers; only MC takes stochastic cell hops. The right panel compares every saved continuous position with independent translation, acceleration or shear solutions. The predeclared tolerance is unchanged.

figures.name: 02_planar_histories
figures.title: Each sampled passage has one encounter, with timing brackets
figures.caption: All 128 seeded particles independently cross the native density midpoint exactly once, and all 128 have one complete encounter. Every density-crossing bracket overlaps its recorded event evidence envelope. Membership uses the full unreduced numerical shock region. Colored entry/exit intervals are sampling brackets, not exact physical crossing times.

figures.name: 03_live_amr
figures.title: Continuous particles and curve histories work through live AMR
figures.caption: Uniform and mixed-level trees both refine and coarsen. Position error stays within the unchanged affine-oracle budget. The mixed-level run explicitly logs the containing-leaf fallback for a missing diagonal neighbor. In the evolved shock run, 17 positive-time nodes are born inside and 22 outside; no node inherits a parent encounter. Inside births are left-censored.

figures.name: 04_restart_guards
figures.title: Restart preserves encounter identity and complete particle state
figures.caption: Outside, active and pending checkpoints reproduce the same native particle observations and complete event records. An active encounter also replays exactly across AMR and coarsening. MC/native transport cannot be changed silently on restart. Predictor outflow is explicitly unsupported: execution aborts before treating a predictor as a completed exit. Counts are engineering checks; scientific approval is still pending.

figures.name: 05_forced_statistics
figures.title: Forcing remains enabled; statistics now come from continuous tracers
figures.caption: The accepted short native 32³ forcing fixture uses 4096 continuous particles and 16 curve nodes. Tracking and optional traces leave the native fluid arrays, particle samples and curve geometry exactly unchanged. Strength values are detector estimates, not calibrated physical plateau Mach numbers. This short box and the inherited forcing heat-bias issue do not establish converged turbulence or scientific approval. Terminal censored views are not extra complete events.

figures.name: 06_forced_histories
figures.title: Inspect actual particle encounter histories
figures.caption: Orange marks a valid inside-shock sample; pale blue marks valid outside; red marks invalid evidence. Rows are fixed particle IDs, not reconstructed trajectories. The histogram counts committed complete episodes for all seeded particles, while right-censored views remain separate in the prior figure. Histories are endpoint-cadence limited.

figures.name: 07_retained_failures
figures.title: Development failures remain visible in the evidence ledger
figures.caption: Early checks caught a missing build, a trace-reader omission, the unexercised diagonal fixture, and an AMR restart contract mismatch. Test counts grew as stronger checks were added; these bars are not a performance or accuracy comparison. The input editor was fixed after repeated sections silently overrode its requested refinement time. All final 35 native checks pass with unchanged numerical tolerances. Original failed inputs and logs are archived.
